definitions.explanation: A mixture of different ingredients, varieties, or elements combined to create a balanced or desired result. Most commonly used in the context of coffee and tea, but also applies to whisky, spices, and other products.

examples.japanese: ブレンド⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{数|すう}{種類|しゅるい}→数種類：28382_suushurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ブレンド⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧です。
examples.english: This is a tea made by blending several types of tea leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原酒|げんしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ブレンド⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This whisky is made by blending multiple base spirits.

notes:
USAGE: ブレンド is a loanword from English "blend." It can be used as a noun (ブレンド) or as a suru-verb (ブレンド⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブレンド⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧ (blended coffee — the default "house coffee" at most Japanese cafes)
- ⟦オリジナル→オリジナル：10829_orijinaru⟧ブレンド (original/house blend)
- ブレンド⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to blend, to mix)
- ブレンド⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (blended tea)

COFFEE CULTURE NOTE: At Japanese ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧ (coffee shops), ブレンド is the standard house coffee made from a mix of beans. It is typically the most affordable and popular option on the menu. Ordering just "ブレンド" is understood to mean a cup of blended coffee.
